title: Will Trump Fire Powell?, Trump Softens Tone on China to Secure Xi Summit | Bloomberg The Pulse 7/17
content:
President Donald Trump said he’s not planning to fire Jerome Powell, and still managed to make it sound like a threat. Trump’s comments capped a hectic few hours that took his pressure campaign against the Federal Reserve chief to a new level — and sent markets into a shortlived nosedive. He ran the idea of sacking Powell by a group of Republican lawmakers late Tuesday. An aide said Wednesday morning he was likely to follow through. Then the president publicly backpedaled – with a major caveat. “I don’t rule out anything, but I think it’s highly unlikely, unless he has to leave for fraud,” Trump said.  Elsewhere, Trump has dialed down his confrontational tone with China in an effort to secure a summit with counterpart Xi Jinping and a trade deal with the world’s second-largest economy.
